assertions.description: Working directory is agentic-starter-kits repo root
Agent matches a supported pattern (standard or Langflow)
assertions.criteria: Standard agents have main.py; Langflow agents have agent.yaml with deploymentModel: flow-import and a flows/ directory. At least one pattern must match.

assertions.description: Agent path argument provided and non-empty
assertions.pass_if: First word of skill args contains a / separator (e.g. langgraph/agentic_rag)

phase-1-deploy.description: Phase 1 deployment gate — if agent was not already deployed, verify /deploy-agents was used (not manual make deploy)

assertions.description: MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN reads from a Kubernetes secret (secretKeyRef), not a hardcoded value. A hardcoded value means /deploy-agents was bypassed — the Helm chart always wires tokens through secrets. Fix: redeploy via /deploy-agents.
Agent startup logs confirm MLflow tracing is enabled (not failed/skipped)
No agent in the namespace has a hardcoded MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN value. /deploy-agents Step 4e checks all agents — if any have hardcoded tokens, /deploy-agents was not run or did not complete Step 4.
assertions.pass_if: For every deployment in the namespace that has MLFLOW_TRACKING_TOKEN, the env var uses valueFrom.secretKeyRef (not a plain value field)

assertions.description: Langflow agents: deployment gate passes if pod is running and /health returns 200 (no /deploy-agents required)
assertions.criteria: For framework=langflow: oc get pods shows langflow pod Running, curl /health returns 200. /deploy-agents check is waived.

post.description: Scaffolding complete — all Phases 0-8 artifacts created

assertions.description: pyproject.toml has pytest marker for agent
All three documentation files updated per Phase 7
assertions.pass_if: README.md, adding-behavioral-tests.md, and agent README all updated with new agent references

assertions.description: Langflow agents extract tool_calls from content_blocks, not MLflow — enrichment gate waived
assertions.criteria: For framework=langflow: result.tool_calls is non-empty after run_task() (populated by _extract_langflow_tool_calls). MLflow enrichment check is waived.

assertions.description: Langflow uses Langfuse, not MLflow — trace structure checks skipped
assertions.criteria: run-btest Phase 3 (trace structure) is skipped for framework=langflow. No MLflow traces to verify.

assertions.pass_if: The run-behavioral-tests skill was invoked for this agent and all validation phases passed (or failures were documented with Jira tickets). If validation has not been run yet, do NOT mark this skill complete — instruct the user to run /agentic-starter-kits-skills:run-behavioral-tests first.
